365:t_5:103.en:
$$桂$$
(But, $$ミムジィ$$... I think someday... I'll have to atone for what I did in the past.)

365:t_5:104.en:
$$桂$$
(The people whose lives were ruined by the birth of the multiverse probably won't forgive me for existing.)

365:t_5:105.en:
$$桂$$
(So... when that day comes, I'll risk my life to do whatever I can...)

365:t_10:5.en:
$n
「...I'll make up for my mistakes myself. And to do that...」

365:t_10:6.en:
$n
(I have to... surpass who I've been... the weakling I used to be...)

365:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I never imagined this would happen... Now I have to redo all my calculations...)

365:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(And without Miss $$スズネ$$, neither $$ジェニオン$$ nor $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ can unleash 100% of its power...)

365:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...$$ＡＧ$$'s maxim No. 36! Don't dwell on things you can't do anything about!」

365:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And so, of course, $$Ｄトレーダー$$ is open 24 hours a day, every day of the year.」

365:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Out of consideration for $n, who's feeling down over there, I'll postpone our ace pilot celebrations until next time.」

365:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, let's put our hearts into today and tomorrow... Business, business!」

365:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We will also be selling antique mobile suits excavated from the $$マウンテンサイクル$$ at $$Ｄトレーダー$$.」

365:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「These bargains are available only here, so don't miss out!」

366:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The $$ターミナル・ベース$$ holding the target is now within combat range.」

366:t_000:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Begin the attack. Remember, this is strictly a diversion.」

366:t_001:0.en:
$$ラム$$
「We've received a transmission from Major $$コンロイ$$! The team has successfully entered the base!」

366:t_001:1.en:
$$ボビー$$
「The first phase of the operation is a success.」

366:t_001:2.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The enemy interception force has deployed!」

366:t_002:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「That damned $c...! Do they know about the man being held at this base!?」

366:t_002:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「...No matter. They're the perfect prey to restore my position after I was shunted off to this dead-end post.」

366:t_002:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I'll bury them here and return to the front lines!」

366:t_002:3.en:
$$モニカ$$
「The enemy commander appears to be $$ギルター・ベローネ$$.」

366:t_002:4.en:
$$ボビー$$
「Then that bad feeling $$セツコ$$ had really was about him...!」

366:t_002:5.en:
$$キャシー$$
「$$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$... That man is here too...」

366:t_002:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Our priority is rescuing $$オルソン$$. This ship will draw the enemy's attention alone until the infiltration team returns.」

366:t_003:0.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Good... We've served our purpose as a diversion. This ship will withdraw.」

366:t_004:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Did you think one ship could take this base without even deploying a strike force...!?」

366:t_004:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I won't let you escape! All forces, pursue them!」

366:t_006:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Where's $$セツコ$$...!? Is the infiltration team safe!?」

366:t_006:3.en:
$n
「$$桂$$ has apparently found $$オルソン$$. $$セツコ$$ has rejoined the infiltration team, and they're escaping.」

366:t_006:4.en:
$n
「We'll buy them time! Can you do it!?」

366:t_006:6.en:
$n
(Thank goodness... It looks like $$バルビエル$$'s $$スフィア・アクト$$ hasn't affected her.)

366:t_006:7.en:
$n
(Did $$セツコ$$'s $$スフィア$$ power cancel it out...?)

366:t_006:8.en:
$$ギルター$$
「That damned $$いがみ合う双子$$...! When did he get over there!?」

366:t_006:9.en:
$$ギルター$$
「But coming in a single machine is no different from coming here to die.」

366:t_006:10.en:
$n
「Quit running your mouth and come at me, $$ギルター・ベローネ$$, you self-proclaimed master strategist.」

366:t_006:11.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You insolent brat! I'll slaughter you before Lord $$バルビエル$$!」

366:t_006:12.en:
$n
「I said, cut the bullshit and come at me already. If you can't hear me, I'll come to you!」

366:t_007:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I-I can't afford to disgrace myself any further before Lord $$バルビエル$$...!」

366:t_008:0.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$! The $$クォーター$$ is here!」

366:t_009:1.en:
$n
「We're fine here. Is everyone on the infiltration team safe?」

366:t_009:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「All that's left is for $$桂$$ to get out.」

366:t_009:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$モーム$$ has gone to pick him up.」

366:t_009:4.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Let's clear out these pests so we can bring $$桂$$ aboard!」

366:t_009:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But first, the big fish is making an appearance.」

366:t_010:1.en:
$n
「You sure took your time making an entrance. Or were you in shock because we escaped?」

366:t_010:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「So my poison really hasn't affected you...」

366:t_010:3.en:
$$竜馬$$
「We broke through $$ガドライト#pilot$$'s $$スフィア・アクト$$ too!」

366:t_010:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The $$スフィア$$'s power acts on the human mind... But with strong resolve, we can resist it!」

366:t_010:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「$n and $$セツコ$$ proved that!」

366:t_010:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You people really are fools. You're so conceited you think you overcame my poison on your own.」

366:t_010:8.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Well, never mind. It's true my poison didn't affect you.」

366:t_010:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「But how will she fare?」

366:t_010:11.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The relief of seeing your comrades arrive creates an opening in your mind... And my poison slips inside...」

366:t_011:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「What are you doing, $n!? $$バルビエル$$ is coming!」

366:t_011:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Farewell, $n. Eventually, I'll have you return $$ジェニオン$$.」

366:t_012:1.en:
$$シン$$
「What's going on!? Those movements aren't human!」

366:t_012:3.en:
$$スズネ$$
「This would be better for you as well.」

366:t_012:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「It seems you understand your position.」

366:t_012:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Then let's go, $$アムブリエル$$.」
